svg.title: PLANUM
svg.desc:
A floor plan reduced to essentials: a room outline with a doorway gap in the left edge, an interior partition, and a diagonal for the sloped ceiling (Dachschraege) the planner was built to reason about.
NOTE for future edits: this is XML, so comments may not contain a double hyphen. An earlier revision did, which made the whole file fail to parse and render as nothing at all inside an img tag. Width and height are also required here, not decorative: an SVG with only a viewBox has no intrinsic size and will not render via img.
